situation_headline: Combo cuts steady near $500/cwt; Choice Cutout recovering with pork ham knuckles surging to $157.
situation_paragraphs: Beef combo cuts held firm on June 19 with Insides Combo at $505.43/cwt (essentially flat, +$0.04/cwt) and Flats & Eyes Combo at $499.76/cwt (-$0.26/cwt). Choice Beef Cutout edged up to $394.37/cwt (+$0.45/cwt), signaling stable demand from the retail channel. 85CL and 50CL lean trim data was not published by USDA on this report date. Pork Ham Knuckles jumped to $157.73/cwt — a notable premium over Ham Insides ($135.16/cwt) and Outsides ($137.00/cwt), with Pork Carcass Cutout at $96.77/cwt.

The 6-month forecast for combo cuts shows a modest upward drift for Insides — 26-week P50 at $518.58/cwt (+2.6% from current $505.43 anchor) — while Flats & Eyes are projected to ease slightly to $493.88/cwt (-1.2%). Both cuts remain well below their 52-week highs ($622.80 and $525.27 respectively), suggesting current pricing offers a reasonable forward-buy window. The absence of 85CL/50CL data this report cycle warrants monitoring next publication for lean trim direction.
